mapper.insert: insert into programming_capabilities (student_number, student_name, id_card, c_language_code_volume, java_code_volume, data_structure_code_volume, java_web_code_volume, python_code_volume, oj_practice_number, other_practice_number) VALUES (#{studentNumber}, #{studentName}, #{idCard}, #{cLanguageCodeVolume}, #{javaCodeVolume}, #{dataStructureCodeVolume}, #{javaWebCodeVolume}, #{pythonCodeVolume}, #{ojPracticeNumber}, #{otherPracticeNumber})

c_language_code_volume = #{cLanguageCodeVolume},
java_code_volume = #{javaCodeVolume},
data_structure_code_volume = #{dataStructureCodeVolume},
java_web_code_volume = #{javaWebCodeVolume},
